limits: Synthetic 16-post bench, current two supported destinations, at most 32 active cells. New destinations need a real formatter, route/package and manual extension integration before selection.
Grouped worklist with per-cell confirmation, not bulk atomic confirmation. One valid export per artwork is reused; one date or handoff does not propagate to neighbors.

Existing 32 confirmed drafts/session, 64 successful draft token receipts, 1MiB JPEG, 4MiB/session, 32MiB/API, 1024 adapter draft rows, ten-minute reviews and two-hour idle expiry remain. History can exhaust capacity before active work completes.
Sessions, drafts, schedules and exports remain temporary API-instance state; reload clears them. No durable Rail/live Library or production writes.
No paid language-quality proof was run for the new batch schema. Canned provider evidence establishes validation and state behavior, not broad free-text accuracy.
Publishing manual. Frontend/extension testing, lint, typecheck, Next build, browser/render QA, detector and actual destination fill/upload/live-grant E2E remain deferred.
